gloss.test.text: Prowal obbyr jeant dy akin dy vel eh jannoo ny va er ny eysht, roish my gow oo rish.

gloss.push.text: Cur jallooyn sauailt (commits) veih'n co-earrooder shoh seose gys GitHub, dy vel coip-sauchys jeu as ad rheynnit.

gloss.repo.text: Pillagh coad y phryjeck as e hennaghys slane dy commits, freayllit dy cadjin er GitHub myrgeddin.

gloss.deploy.text: Cur lhieggan noa bio, m.s. er shirveishagh raad ta sleih jannoo ymmyd jeh.

gloss.pr.text: Fenaght dy vel caghlaaghyn branch er nyn jeeaghyn as er nyn gur stiagh 'sy phrimlhieggan.

tour.welcome.title: Failt ort gys AI-gile
tour.welcome.text: Bord raad ta possanyn AI jannoo yn obbyr, as t'ou uss reaghey, prowal as goaill rish. Shoh kys dy gheddyn dty raad mygeayrt.
tour.welcome.why: Yn smooinaght: ta ny possanyn jannoo yn obbyr laccoil, as cha vel oo fakin agh ny ta feme er dooinney.
tour.rail.title: Dty phryjeckyn
tour.rail.text: Thie, dty phost-stiagh as Çhaghteraghtyn, as eisht un ikon son dy chooilley phryjeck. Ta diamant purpur soilshaghey dy vel red ennagh ayns shen fuirraght ort. Tayrn ny ikonyn dy chur ad 'syn ordyr bare lhiat.
tour.rail.short: Pryjeckyn 'sy rail (er y vun er çhellvane); ta diamantyn purpur soilshaghey dy vel red ennagh fuirraght ort.
tour.rail.why: Ta un shilley ginsh dhyt c'raad ta feme ort, gyn veg y osley.
tour.inbox.title: Dty phost-stiagh
tour.inbox.text: Dy chooilley nhee ta fuirraght ort, trooid dy chooilley phryjeck: feyshtyn, reddyn nagh vod agh uss y yannoo, as reddyn dy phrowal. Cliklee er chip dy akin yn sorch shen ny lomarcan.
tour.inbox.short: Ooilley ta fuirraght ort, er dy chooilley ard. Cliklee er chip son un sorch.
tour.inbox.why: Cha lhisagh eh ve orrin goll gys dy chooilley phryjeck dy akin ny ta feme ort.
tour.foryou.title: Dhyts
tour.foryou.text: Er bord, ta'n colloo shoh cummal ny ta fuirraght ort 'sy phryjeck shen. Foshil prowal, gow trooid ny kesmadyn echey, as eisht Gow rish ny Cur er-ash lesh oyr.
tour.foryou.short: Carn y phryjeck shoh dhyts: prowal, as eisht Gow rish ny Cur er-ash.
tour.foryou.why: Cha bee ny possanyn dy bragh cowrey nyn obbyr hene jeant: t'ou uss goaill rish. Myr shen ta'n cairys ayns dty laueyn.
tour.chat.title: Çhaghteraghtyn
tour.chat.text: Loayr rish leeideilee dty phryjeckyn as rish dty chaarjyn ayns shoh. Foshil co-loayrtys carrey dy eam er, lesh feeshan as rheynn screen.
tour.chat.short: Co-loayrtyssyn lesh leeideilee as caarjyn. Eam er carrey veih'n cho-loayrtys oc.
tour.chat.why: Ta ny leeideilee cur dty smooinaghtyn ayns cartyn as plan, as cha bee veg troggit derrey ver oo GO.
tour.setup.title: Soiaghyn
tour.setup.text: Dty ennym, dty chengey as dty chummey. Ta dty chaarjyn as dty chuirraghyn ayns shoh myrgeddin, as ta Tashtey freayll coip-sauchys jeh dty vuird gagh laa.
tour.setup.short: Dty hoiaghyn, caarjyn as coipyn-sauchys. Er çhellvane t'eh 'sy menu heose.

gloss.title: 📖 Goan mynit
gloss.about: Ny goan ver oo er ayns AI-gile, ayns goan aashagh: troggal eh, caghlaa eh dy sauchey, freayll eh goll son y sleih ta jannoo ymmyd jeh, as gobbraghey myr possan lesh AI.
gloss.about.noai: Ny goan ver oo er ayns AI-gile, ayns goan aashagh: troggal eh, caghlaa eh dy sauchey, freayll eh goll son y sleih ta jannoo ymmyd jeh, as gobbraghey myr possan.
gloss.qa.text: Giare son quality assurance: ny prowallyn hene-obbragh ta roie roish my hed red erbee bio. Tra ta QA jiarg, hie red ennagh rongagh, as cha vod eh goll bio derrey vees shen kiartit.
gloss.release.text: Baggey enmyssit dy obbyr jeant ta goll bio cooidjagh, lesh noteyn giare er ny ren caghlaa. Ta 🚀 Releases screeu ny noteyn veih ny cartyn jeant.
gloss.rollback.text: Goll er-ash gys y lhieggan s'jerree va gobbraghey tra ta lhieggan noa jannoo trubbyl. Ayns AI-gile, t'eh jannoo rolley-jeeaghyn jeh ny kesmadyn goll er-ash screeuit er gagh caghlaa.
gloss.live.text: Y lhieggan firrinagh ta sleih jannoo ymmyd jeh, cha nee coip son prowal reddyn. Ta coadee gra production rish myrgeddin.
gloss.change.text: Caghlaa plannit er red ennagh ta sleih croghey er, screeuit sheese hoshiaght: cre, cre'n fa, y gaue, cuin, as kys dy gholl er-ash er. Toshee fer lesh 🔀 Trog caghlaa.
gloss.risk.text: Red ennagh oddagh goll rongagh, lesh scoar er cre cho cosoylagh as cre cho olk as veagh eh. Ta ⚠️ Gauaghyn freayll ad ayns un rolley, yn scoar syrjey hoshiaght, gagh fer lesh date dy yeeaghyn er reesht.
gloss.chgwin.text: Ny traaghyn tra oddys caghlaaghyn goll bio, myr fastyr Jemayrt kiune. Mooie jeh uinnag cha vod cart caghlaa ve cooilleenit, mannagh nee eignys t'ayn.
gloss.gonogo.text: Vote tappee roish my hed caghlaa bio: ta gagh peiagh ta feme er goaill rish gra Go ny No go. Cha jed eh er agh tra t'ad ooilley cordail.
gloss.approval.text: Fuirraght son "ta" roish my hoshiaghys yn obbyr. Ta cart ta carrey troggal, ny caghlaa, fuirraght ayns ✅ Coardailyn derrey ver oo dty OK ny obbys oo eh.
gloss.quiettime.text: Tammylt dy hraa, myr stream, demo ny yn oie, tra nagh jed veg bio. Ta ny possanyn tannaghtyn gobbraghey as prowal, agh ta goll bio fuirraght derrey vees eh harrish. Ayns ynnydyn elley t'eh enmyssit change freeze.
gloss.service.text: Red ennagh hrog oo ta sleih croghey er, myr ynnyd-eggey ny app, as kiarail er ny ghoaill jeh dy vod eh tannaghtyn gobbraghey. Cur tick er "Ta'n pryjeck shoh ny hirveish" as insh cre t'eh dy hebbal, quoi ta jannoo ymmyd jeh as quoi ta er-cheau.
gloss.uptime.text: Prowal hene-obbragh, gagh paart dy vinnidyn, dy vel dty hirveish foast freggyrt. My t'eh failleil paart dy keayrtyn fer lurg fer, ta AI-gile fosley cart tecaght er e hon hene.
gloss.statuspage.text: Duillag phobblagh ta soilshaghey vel shirveish gobbraghey (glass, oranse ny jiarg) lesh y naight s'noa, dy vod y sleih ta jannoo ymmyd jeh jeeaghyn er ayns ynnyd jeh fenaght.
gloss.incident.text: Red ennagh ta brisht son y sleih ta jannoo ymmyd jeh nish, myr yn ynnyd-eggey ve ass obbyr. Ta cart 🔥 tecaght goll roish y streeu: t'eh y chied red dy gheddyn eh gobbraghey reesht.
gloss.major.text: Tecaght feer vooar: ymmodee sleih bentyn rish, ny argid ny data ayns gaue. Ta un chramman cur dy chooilley phossan er (swarm), doostey quoi erbee ta er-cheau as fenaght son naight stayd gagh 30 minnid.
gloss.oncall.text: Ve yn fer ta freggyrt tra ta red ennagh brishey, eer 'syn oie. Ta oltey possan er-cheau ec gagh shirveish ta doostit hoshiaght son ny tecaghtyn echey.
gloss.replyby.text: Cre cho liauyr as oddys cart fuirraght son y chied reggyrt, son sampleyr oor son tecaght. Lurg shen ta clag jiarg echey, dy nagh bee veg jarroodit dy kiune. T'eh enmyssit response target myrgeddin.
gloss.postmortem.text: Shilley giare er-ash lurg tecaght: cre haghyr, cre ren cooney as cre lhisagh caghlaa, gyn cur y foill er peiagh erbee. Cha vod tecaght ve dooint fegooish fer.
gloss.problem.text: Yn oyr follit cooyl jeh un tecaght ny ny smoo. Ta cart 🧩 doilleeid chaglym tecaghtyn ta cheet er-ash dy kinjagh, dy vod yn oyr ve feddynit as kiartit son dy bragh.
gloss.rootcause.text: Yn oyr firrinagh ren red ennagh brishey, cha nee agh ny honnick oo goll rongagh. Kiartee yn bun-oyr as cha jig y tecaght er-ash.
gloss.workaround.text: Aght dy reayll reddyn gobbraghey derrey vees y kiartaghey firrinagh aarloo, myr cur red ennagh er reesht tra t'eh er hassoo. T'eh screeuit er y chart doilleeid dy nagh bee orrin peiagh erbee dy obbraghey magh eh reesht.
gloss.knownerror.text: Doilleeid ta'n oyr eck er ny hoiggal as ta aght mygeayrt eck, agh nagh vel kiartit foast. Ta 🧩 Marranyn enmyssit cur rolley jeu, dy jean dy chooilley pheiagh ymmyd jeh'n aght mygeayrt ayns ynnyd jeh cleiy reesht.
gloss.runbook.text: Saraghyn kesmad er kesmad son kiartaghey sorch trubbyl ta fys orrin er, dy vod eh ve jeant er yn aght cheddin, dy tappee, gagh keayrt. Lurg tecaght vooar, foddee yn possan fer y chur roish dhyt son OK.
gloss.backup.text: Coip sauailt jeh dty data veih roie, dy hoit er-ash er my ta red ennagh caillt ny jeeghit. Ta AI-gile jannoo coip-sauchys jeh dty vuird gagh laa.
gloss.restore.text: Cur data er-ash veih coip-sauchys. Cha vel coip-sauchys coontit dy firrinagh derrey ta fys ayd dy vod eh ve aa-hoit, myr shen t'eh feeu prowal eh nish as reesht.

gloss.dod.text: Rolley-jeeaghyn giare y phossan er cre ta "jeant" dy ghra, myr prowit as mynit, roish my vees cart currit dhyt. Ta'n sheshey echey, Kys ta Aarloo jeeaghyn, gra cuin ta cart baghtal dy-liooar dy hoshiaght.
gloss.testpile.text: Ny cartyn jeant ta fuirraght ort dy phrowal, fer lurg fer. Gow rish fer ny cur er-ash eh lesh note, as ta’n nah fer cheet seose.
gloss.retro.text: Shilley er-ash er kys ta'n possan gobbraghey, dy choardail er un red dy yannoo ny share. Ayns AI-gile, ta retro cur caghlaa roish er aghtyn obbyr y phossan, as t'ou gra Go ny Cha nel foast.

gloss.swarm.text: Dy chooilley laue er y deck: ta gagh possan faagail obbyr elley dy chooney lesh un phryjeck erreeishagh derrey vees eh reaghit. Ta pryjeckyn elley fuirraght 'sy traa cheddin.
gloss.scrummaster.text: Yn fer ta freayll yn obbyr goll: t'eh fakin cartyn er hassoo, brodey ny possanyn as cur cooinaghtyn dhyt er ny ta fuirraght. Ayns AI-gile, ta'n Leeideilagh Scrum Mainshter jannoo shoh ayns dy chooilley phryjeck.

guide.inc.hi:
- Ta **tecaght** 🔥 ny chart son "t'eh brisht nish". T'eh lheim roish y streeu as ta oirr jiarg er.
- Tra t'ou dooney eh, t'eh fenaght three feyshtyn giare: cre haghyr, cre'n fa, cre nee mayd y chaghlaa.
- My ta'n red cheddin brishey reesht, cur ny tecaghtyn cooidjagh fo un **doilleeid** 🧩 lesh e bun-oyr as aght mygeayrt.
- Ta'n kiartaghey firrinagh goll trooid aghin caghlaa.
guide.inc.steps:
1. Trog y tecaght: **Cart noa**, sorch **🔥 tecaght**.
2. Kiartee eh hoshiaght. Jean ymmyd jeh'n aght mygeayrt my ta fer er y chart doilleeid.
3. Scugh eh gys Jeant. Lhieen **Cre haghyr**, **Cre'n fa**, **Cre nee mayd y chaghlaa**, as eisht **Jeant**.
4. Haghyr eh roie? Fenee jeh dty leeideilagh ny tecaghtyn y chur cooidjagh fo chart **🧩 doilleeid** (ta ny saraghyn fo *Son jaagentyn*).
5. Ta'n cart doilleeid soilshaghey yn **Bun-oyr**, yn **Aght mygeayrt**, ny tecaghtyn as yn aghin caghlaa.
6. Ta tecaghtyn ny s'anmey goll stiagh 'sy doilleeid cheddin; ta'n cart cur rolley jeu ooilley.
7. Trog aghin caghlaa son y kiartaghey. Ta'n doilleeid fuirraght foshlit derrey vees y caghlaa shen jeant.
guide.inc.full:
- **Cre'n fa t'eh scansoil:** ta tecaght mychione goll er-ash gys yn aght cadjin dy tappee. Ta doilleeid mychione yn oyr. My t'ou measkey ad, t'ou mooghey yn aile cheddin reesht as reesht.
- **Tecaght:** cha vel foill 'sy post-mortem. T'eh gra cre haghyr, cre'n fa, as cre ta caghlaa dy nagh daghyr eh reesht. Tra ta gaue veih rolley ny gauaghyn taghyrt, ta tecaght currit stiagh er dty hon.
- **Doilleeid:** un oyr, ymmodee tecaghtyn. Ta'n bun-oyr yn oyr cooyl yn oyr (cha nee "va'n shirveishagh ass obbyr" agh "ta'n script deploy lhiggey shaghey ny prowallyn"). Ta'n aght mygeayrt ny ta peiagh erbee jannoo derrey vees y kiartaghey currit magh.
- **Kiangley:** ta tecaght bentyn rish un doilleeid. Ta'n kiangley ry-akin er y daa chart. My t'ou kiangley eh rish doilleeid elley, t'eh scughey.
- **Aghin caghlaa:** ta'n kiartaghey ny chaghlaa myr caghlaa erbee elley, lesh oyr, gaue as raad er-ash. Ta'n doilleeid fuirraght foshlit derrey vees y caghlaa shen jeant.
- **Cliaghtaghyn mie:** jeeagh er doilleeidyn foshlit ec gagh retro; my ta'n oyr cheddin ec three tecaghtyn, jean y doilleeid; freayll aghtyn mygeayrt giare dy-liooar dy gheiyrt orroo fo boirey.

guide.svc.hi:
- Insh da'n bord cre ny pryjeckyn ta nyn **shirveishyn**: cre t'ad dy hebbal, quoi ta jannoo ymmyd jeu as yn enmys eggey oc. Eisht ta'n bord freayll arrey er yn enmys er dty hon.
- Tra ta shirveish scuirr dy reggyrt, ta'n bord troggal **un tecaght** er e hon hene. Ta cart ta fuirraght ro liauyr soilshaghey clag ⏰ jiarg "freggyrt roish".
- Ta tecaght feer olk geddyn y cramman **🚨 Mooar**: ta un chliklee doostey yn jaagent kiart as ginsh dhyt. Ta duillag stayd phobblagh soilshaghey da caarjyn cre ta goll er.
- Ta ny t'ou gynsaghey freayllit: **🧩 Marranyn enmyssit**, **📖 Runbooks** (kys dy chiartaghey X) as **📝 Scrudeyrys lurg y tecaght** er gagh tecaght vooar.
- Freayll arrey er ny **🗂️ Reddyn** ta dty hirveish croghey orroo (dateyn ass bree, coipyn-sauchys), yn **🔐 Scrudeyrys roshtyn** gagh 90 laa, **🚀 Releases**, y rolley **📈 Lheiys** as, un cheayrt 'sy vee, yn **📆 Scrudeyrys** (lesh cagliagh tokens 'sy vee my sailt).
guide.svc.steps:
1. Er bord y phryjeck cliklee er **🎨 Cummey**. 'Sy kishtey **Soiaghyn y phryjeck** fow yn ayrn **🛎️ Shirveish**. Cur tick er **Ta'n pryjeck shoh ny hirveish** as lhieen cre t'eh dy hebbal, quoi ta jannoo ymmyd jeh as yn enmys eggey echey.
2. Reih yn **Jaagent er-cheau** (y leeideilagh, dy cadjin) as cur tick er **Pobblagh** my oddys caarjyn eh y akin er y duillag stayd. My sailt, screeu **Cagliagh tokens 'sy vee** dy nagh vod un phryjeck yn budjet slane y cheau. Cliklee er **Sauail**.
3. Jeeagh er bine y phryjeck er **Thie**: ta glass gra dy vel yn enmys freggyrt. My t'eh scuirr dy reggyrt, hig cart tecaght er e hon hene.
4. Foshil y cart tecaght shen. Fer olk? Cliklee er **🚨 Mooar**. Cliklee er **Jean jerrey er y tecaght vooar** tra t'eh harrish.
5. Ta cartyn ta fuirraght ro liauyr soilshaghey ⏰ jiarg. Foshil ad shen hoshiaght. Ta'n creear post-stiagh **Deisk: tecaghtyn** soilshaghey agh tecaghtyn veih caarjyn as veih'n furriym aaghraa.
6. Cliklee er **⋯ Ny smoo** er y bord, as eisht **🗂️ Reddyn**. Cliklee er **+ Cur stiagh red** son gagh shirveishagh, ennym-ynnyd, certificate, ogher, repo ny soilleyder. Cur stiagh date ass bree as, son data, c'raad ta coip-sauchys jeh as cre cho mennick. Cliklee er **Coip-sauchys jeant jiu** lurg gagh coip-sauchys.
7. Er cart tecaght, jeeagh er y bosk **📖 Runbooks**: t'eh cur rolley jeh ny noteyn kys-dy-yannoo ta cordail. Cliklee er **Foshil** dy lhaih fer.
8. Lurg da tecaght vooar ve jeant, ta'n cart echey soilshaghey **📝 Scrudeyrys lurg y tecaght**. Lhaih yn timeline, as eisht cliklee er **Jean cart** rish gagh red ta feeu caghlaa.
9. Cliklee er **⋯ Ny smoo**, as eisht **🧩 Marranyn enmyssit** dy akin doilleeidyn ta aght mygeayrt oc. Cliklee er **🚀 Releases**, screeu ennym myr v1.3 as cliklee er **🚀 Release noa** dy chaglym ny cartyn jeant ayns noteyn. Ta **↩ Roll back** troggal cart lesh rolley-jeeaghyn dy gholl er-ash.
10. Cliklee er **⋯ Ny smoo**, as eisht **📆 Scrudeyrys** un cheayrt 'sy vee: jean ymmyd jeh **← Ny s'leaie** as **Ny s'anmey →** dy chaghlaa yn vee, as **✍️ Giare-choontey** son giare-choontey daa linney veih'n jaagent er-cheau.
11. Cliklee er **⋯ Ny smoo**, as eisht **📈 Lheiys** (ayns y menu **❓ Cooney** myrgeddin) dy akin smooinaghtyn retro, gniomyn scrudeyrys as kiartaghyn doilleeid ayns un rolley. Ayns **Soiaghyn**, cliklee er **Roie scrudeyrys roshtyn nish** dy akin quoi oddys goll stiagh, as eisht **Freayll** ny **Scugh ass** son gagh fer.
guide.svc.full:
- **Mynphoyntyn y shirveish:** ayns **🎨 Cummey**, **Soiaghyn y phryjeck**, **🛎️ Shirveish** t'ou gra cre ta pryjeck dy hebbal, da quoi, ec cre'n enmys eggey as quoi ta er-cheau. Cha vel agh ny pryjeckyn ver oo tick orroo coontit myr shirveishyn.
- **Bine traa ec obbyr:** gagh paart dy vinnidyn ta'n bord fenaght jeh'n enmys eggey vel eh bio. Ta glass kiart; ta jiarg gra nagh dug eh freggyrt. Ta three jeeaghyn ny lurg y cheilley gyn freggyrt fosley un tecaght, dy bragh carn, as ta gaghlin gra cuin v'eh er-ash ("Ec obbyr reesht lurg N minnid").
- **Freggyrt roish ⏰:** ta traa freggyrt ec gagh sorch dy chart (tecaght mysh oor, aghin carrey laa ny jees, bug mysh shiaghtin). Ta cartyn anmagh goll jiarg as ta'n brief gagh laa cur rolley jeu. Ta ad shoh nyn yeearreeyn, cha nee gialdynyn.
- **🚨 Mooar:** son tecaght ta jannoo assee da ymmodee ymmydeyryn ny cur argid ny data ayns gaue. Ta un chliklee cur y swarm er, doostey yn jaagent er-cheau, cur un note hood as fenaght son gaghlin "Status:" gagh 30 minnid.
- **Duillag stayd:** ta duillag phobblagh soilshaghey gagh shirveish pobblagh myr glass, oranse ny jiarg lesh y linney stayd s'noa. Cha vel ee dy bragh soilshaghey teks cart, agh y linney reih uss ny'n jaagent.
- **Deisk shirveish:** ta coontyssyn veih caarjyn as veih'n furriym aaghraa reaghit ayns **Aghin**, **Tecaght** ny **Smooinaght**. Ta'n creear post-stiagh (**Deisk: ooilley**, **Deisk: aghinyn** as myr shen) soilshaghey un sorch. Ta coontey ta jeeaghyn myr cart t'ayd hannah gra "t'eh jeeaghyn myr AIG-12" lesh cramman **Kiangle**.
- **🧩 Marranyn enmyssit:** doilleeid ta fys er yn oyr eck as ta aght mygeayrt eck, nagh vel kiartit foast. T'ad ayns rolley son gagh pryjeck as son ny pryjeckyn ooilley, as t'ad goll stiagh ayns brief gagh jaagent, dy nagh jean peiagh erbee ronsaghey daa cheayrt.
- **📖 Runbooks:** noteyn giare kesmad er kesmad er kys dy chiartaghey red. Ta cart tecaght soilshaghey ny fir ta cordail rish yn ard-ennym echey. Lurg scrudeyrys, foddee yn jaagent runbook noa y chur roish as t'ou gra Go ny Cha nel foast.
- **📝 Scrudeyrys lurg y tecaght:** lurg da tecaght vooar ve jeant, ta'n jaagent screeu **Timeline**, **Cre ren cooney** as **Cre dy chaghlaa**. Ta gagh gniom cheet dy ve ny chart lesh **Jean cart**. Mannagh vel jaagent erbee rouyr, t'ou screeu eh oo hene.
- **🗂️ Reddyn:** y rolley jeh ny reddyn ta shirveish croghey orroo, lesh **Sorch** (shirveishagh, ennym-ynnyd, certificate, ogher, repo, soilleyder, elley). Foddee kianglaghyn gys cartyn ny enmyssyn eggey ve ec gagh fer. Cha nel ogher agh e ennym veih Reddyn follit, dy bragh yn ogher hene. Foddee cartyn tecaght as caghlaa soilshaghey cre t'ad **bentyn rish**.
- **Ass bree as coipyn-sauchys:** gagh laa ta'n bord jeeaghyn er dateyn ass bree as er eash ny coipyn-sauchys. Hig cart roish my hed red ennagh ass bree ny tra ta coip-sauchys ro henn, as un cheayrt 'sy vee ta cart prowal aa-hoiaghey cur ayns cooinaghtyn dhyt nagh vel coip-sauchys nagh ren oo rieau prowal dy aa-hoiaghey agh treishteil.
- **Slaynt ny shirveishee:** ta'n bord freayll arrey er CPU, cooinaghtyn as disk er dty hirveishee as t'eh troggal cart noaghey roish my vees ad lane.
- **🔐 Scrudeyrys roshtyn:** gagh 90 laa ta un chart cur rolley jeh kianglaghyn rheynn, ayrnyn caarjyn as reddyn follit freayllit (ennymyn ny lomarcan), gagh fer lesh **Freayll** ny **Scugh ass**. Roie eh nish veih **Soiaghyn**.
- **🚀 Releases:** ta release ny vaggey enmyssit jeh ny cartyn haink dy ve jeant neayr's y fer s'jerree, lesh noteyn giare. Ta **↩ Roll back** troggal cart lesh rolley ny kesmadyn dy gholl er-ash.
- **📈 Lheiys:** coyrleyn retro, gniomyn scrudeyrys as kiartaghyn doilleeid ayns un rolley, oddys oo creearey liorish pryjeck, dy nagh bee smooinaghtyn mie caillt eddyr retros.
- **📆 Scrudeyrys mee:** un duillag son gagh shirveish son un vee: tecaghtyn foshlit as dooint, traa mean dy chiartaghey, cartyn ren freggyrt roish y chagliagh traa, traa ec obbyr, tokens ymmydit as ny cheeymyn syrjey er shirveishee. Foshil eh veih **⋯ Ny smoo → 📆 Scrudeyrys** ny veih **Soiaghyn y phryjeck → Shirveish**.
- **Cagliagh tokens 'sy vee:** ayns **Soiaghyn y phryjeck → Shirveish** foddee oo cagliagh tokens son y vee y hoiaghey. Ec 80% ta'n brief gagh laa cur rabbagh dhyt; ec 100% ta roiaghyn 'sy background son y phryjeck shen fuirraght derrey yn nah vee ny derrey ver oo yn cagliagh seose. Ta dty Ghoostey hene foast gobbraghey.
- **Cliaghtaghyn mie:** lhieen mynphoyntyn y shirveish hoshiaght, freayll yn enmys eggey kiart, jeeagh er bine y stayd gagh laa, screeu mychione gagh tecaght vooar as jeeagh er y rolley lheiys lurg gagh retro, as lhaih yn scrudeyrys mee choud as ta'n vee noa ayns dty chooinaghtyn.

6. Fo **🎥 Shamyryn meeiteil**, foshil shamyr pryjeck dy loayrt rish y possan slane echey ayns un cho-loayrtys. Cliklee er **🎥 Gow stiagh 'syn eam** son yn eam coraa ny feeshan echey.

guide.msg.full:
- **Un ynnyd son dy chooilley cho-loayrtys:** ta **💬 Çhaghteraghtyn** cur rolley jeh leeideilee, caarjyn, possanyn as Shamyryn meeiteil cooidjagh, yn fer s'noa hoshiaght. Cha vel ny creearyn caghlaa agh ny t'ou fakin; cha vel veg scughit ny scryssit ass.
- **Leeideilee:** ta leeideilagh ec gagh pryjeck. Ta'n co-loayrtys oc yn raad s'tappee dy eysht red jeh'n possan shen gyn cart y yannoo. Ta gagh freggyrt ny roie jaagent, myr shen t'eh jannoo ymmyd jeh tokens.
- **Caarjyn:** ta carrey roie yn AI-gile oc hene. Ta dty DMyn goll eddyr ny daa vord eu, ayns coad follit, as t'ad freayllit ayns coad follit er y co-earrooder shoh myrgeddin. Ta freggyrtyn, freggyrtyn emoji as poyntyn screeu gobbraghey myr ayns app co-loayrtys erbee.
- **Possanyn:** uss as daa jaagent ny smoo, veih pryjeck erbee. Ta gagh çhaghteraght t'ou screeu doostey gagh oltey un cheayrt dy reggyrt, myr shen ta possan mooar jannoo ymmyd jeh ny smoo tokens.
- **Shamyryn meeiteil:** fer son gagh pryjeck, lesh ny jaagentyn er y possan echey myr oltee, noa dy kinjagh. Ta'n eam ayns Shamyr Meeiteil son uss ny lomarcan: cha vod caarjyn ny jaagentyn goll stiagh ayn.
- **Eamyn:** ta eamyn coraa as feeshan gobbraghey dy chooyl trooid shirveishagh eam AI-gile hene, er dty hon as er son dty charrey; veg dy hoiaghey seose. Dy yannoo ymmyd jeh dty hirveishagh LiveKit hene, foshil **Soiaghyn → Eamyn → Mynphoyntagh**.
- **Rheynn y screen:** ayns eam cliklee er **🖥️ Rheynn y screen**; ta'n brawseyr fenaght cre'n screen, uinnag ny taab. Cliklee er **🖥️ Scuirr dy rheynn** dy scuirr.
- **Microfone, camera as loayreyder:** ta reihder son gagh fer ec panel yn eam, feeu lesh headset ny nah camera.
- **Tra nagh vel y microfone ny'n camera gobbraghey:** ta "lhiettit" gra dy dooyrt y brawseyr cha nee: lhig eh ayns barr yn enmys. Ta "cha row eh feddynit" gra nagh vel veg kianglt ny er. Ta "ayns ymmyd ec app elley" gra dy vel eh ec app eam elley: dooin y fer shen. Foddee oo clashtyn foast dy kinjagh.
- **Eam ta tuittym:** t'ou fakin "Kiangley reesht…" hoshiaght. My t'eh jerrey, jeeagh er dty eddyr-voggyl as eam reesht.
- **Cliaghtaghyn mie:** jean ymmyd jeh possan ny Shamyr Meeiteil son feysht da ymmodee jaagentyn ayns ynnyd jeh coip y chur, cur dty vicrofone ec tostey tra nagh vel oo loayrt, as rheynn un uinnag ayns ynnyd y screen slane.
